modmenu.summaryTranslation.torchok: Automatically places torches as you walk in dark areas
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.torchok: Automatically places torches from your inventory when the light level drops below a configurable threshold
torchok.midnightconfig.title: TorchOK
torchok.midnightconfig.enabled.tooltip: When enabled, torches will be automatically placed from your inventory in dark areas
torchok.midnightconfig.threshold.tooltip: The light level below which a torch will be placed automatically (0 = pitch black, 15 = full daylight)
